```{r}
df <- read.csv("CaseStudy1-data.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

df_clean <- df %>%
  select(-EmployeeCount, -StandardHours, -Over18, -EmployeeNumber, -ID) %>%
  mutate(
    Attrition = factor(Attrition, levels = c("No", "Yes")),
    AnnualSalary = MonthlyIncome * 12,
    ReplacementCostMultiplier = case_when(
      JobLevel == 1 ~ 0.50,  
      JobLevel == 2 ~ 1.00,  
      JobLevel == 3 ~ 1.50,  
      JobLevel == 4 ~ 2.50,  
      JobLevel == 5 ~ 4.00,  
      TRUE          ~ 1.00))

attrition_totals <- table(df_clean$Attrition)
attrition_pcts   <- round(prop.table(attrition_totals) * 100, 2)
cat(paste("Total Employees Retained ('No')  :", attrition_totals["No"],  "profiles (", attrition_pcts["No"],  "%)\n"))
cat(paste("Total Employees Departed ('Yes') :", attrition_totals["Yes"], "profiles (", attrition_pcts["Yes"], "%)\n"))
cat(paste("Total Organizational Sample Size  :", sum(attrition_totals),   "observations\n"))

df_viz <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(Attrition = factor(Attrition, levels = c("No", "Yes")))

theme_corporate <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, color = "#333333"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "#666666", margin = margin(b = 10)),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f2f2f2", color = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, color = "#333333"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom")}

p2 <- ggplot(df_viz, aes(x = JobRole, y = MonthlyIncome, fill = Attrition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2ca02c", "#d62728")) +
  labs(
    title = "High Impact: Compensation Compression Matrix",
    subtitle = "Turnover concentrates within lower salary bands in frontline positions.",
    x = "Assigned Operational Job Role", y = "Monthly Gross Compensation ($)") + 
  theme_corporate() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p4 <- ggplot(df_viz, aes(x = MaritalStatus, y = DistanceFromHome, fill = Attrition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2ca02c", "#d62728")) +
  labs(
    title = "Hidden Trend: Commute Vulnerability vs. Family Structure",
    subtitle = "Single employees traveling long distances represent isolated flight risks.",
    x = "Marital Status", y = "Commute Distance From Home (Miles)") + 
  theme_corporate()

p_salary_by_rank <- ggplot(df_viz, aes(x = Attrition, y = MonthlyIncome, fill = Attrition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.75, outlier.color = "#d62728", outlier.size = 1.5) +
  facet_grid(. ~ JobLevel) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2ca02c", "#d62728")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Frito-Lay Compensation Matrix: Attrition Dynamics Across All 5 Ranks",
    subtitle = "Analysis of wage bands within specific hierarchy tiers highlights low entry-level pay ceilings.",
    x = "Voluntary Attrition Status",
    y = "Monthly Gross Salary ($)",
    fill = "Flight Outcome") + 
  theme_corporate()

# --- DIAGNOSTIC 2: INCOME VS ATTRITION FACETED BY JOB CATEGORY (JOB ROLES) ---
p_salary_by_role <- ggplot(df_viz, aes(x = Attrition, y = MonthlyIncome, fill = Attrition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.75, outlier.color = "#d62728", outlier.size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ JobRole, scales = "free_y", nrow = 3) +  # free_y permits localized focus per category band
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2ca02c", "#d62728")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Frito-Lay Compensation Matrix: Attrition Profiles by Operational Job Category",
    subtitle = "Localized wage scales permit immediate auditing of individual departmental risk triggers.",
    x = "Voluntary Attrition Status",
    y = "Monthly Gross Salary ($)",
    fill = "Flight Outcome") + 
  theme_corporate()

p5 <- ggplot(df_viz, aes(x = OverTime, fill = Attrition)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2ca02c", "#d62728")) +
  labs(
    title = "High Impact: OverTime Strain Curve",
    subtitle = "Voluntary turnover nearly triples among staff working extended hours.",
    x = "OverTime Status", y = "Proportion of Workforce Class", fill = "Attrition") + 
  theme_corporate()

p6 <- ggplot(df_viz, aes(x = Attrition, y = HourlyRate, fill = Attrition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2ca02c", "#d62728")) +
  labs(
    title = "Low Impact: Hourly Rate Irrelevance",

    x = "Observed Attrition Outcome", y = "Hourly Pay Rate ($)", fill = "Attrition") + 
  theme_corporate()

print(p_salary_by_rank)
print(p_salary_by_role)
print(p5)
print(p6)
print(p2)
print(p4)

set.seed(42)
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(df_clean$Attrition, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_set  <- df_clean[trainIndex, ]
test_set   <- df_clean[-trainIndex, ]

attrition_model <- glm(Attrition ~ OverTime + JobRole + MonthlyIncome + 
                       MaritalStatus + DistanceFromHome, 
                       data = train_set, family = "binomial")
summary(attrition_model)

test_preds_prob <- predict(attrition_model, newdata = test_set, type = "response")

INCENTIVE_COST <- 200    
SUCCESS_RATE   <- 0.40   

evaluate_financial_impact <- function(threshold, probabilities, actual_data) {
  predicted_class <- ifelse(probabilities > threshold, "Yes", "No")
  results_df <- data.frame(
    Actual       = actual_data$Attrition,
    Predicted    = predicted_class,
    AnnualSalary = actual_data$AnnualSalary,
    Multiplier   = actual_data$ReplacementCostMultiplier,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  results_df <- results_df %>%
    mutate(
      IndividualReplacementCost = AnnualSalary * Multiplier,
      Scenario_Cost = case_when(
        Actual == "No"  & Predicted == "No"  ~ 0,
        Actual == "Yes" & Predicted == "No"  ~ IndividualReplacementCost,
        Actual == "Yes" & Predicted == "Yes" ~ INCENTIVE_COST + ((1 - SUCCESS_RATE) * IndividualReplacementCost),
        Actual == "No"  & Predicted == "Yes" ~ INCENTIVE_COST))
  
  baseline_cost <- sum(ifelse(results_df$Actual == "Yes", results_df$IndividualReplacementCost, 0))
  model_cost    <- sum(results_df$Scenario_Cost)
  net_savings   <- baseline_cost - model_cost
  flagged_cnt   <- sum(results_df$Predicted == "Yes")
  saved_cnt     <- sum(results_df$Actual == "Yes" & results_df$Predicted == "Yes") * SUCCESS_RATE
  
  return(data.frame(
    Threshold         = threshold,
    Baseline_Cost     = baseline_cost,
    Model_Cost        = model_cost,
    Net_Savings       = net_savings,
    Employees_Flagged = flagged_cnt,
    Turnovers_Averted = saved_cnt))}

thresholds     <- seq(0.05, 0.70, by = 0.025)
financial_grid <- map_df(thresholds, evaluate_financial_impact, 
                         probabilities = test_preds_prob, 
                         actual_data = test_set)

optimal_strategy <- financial_grid %>% filter(Net_Savings == max(Net_Savings)) %>% head(1)
print(optimal_strategy)

savings_plot <- ggplot(financial_grid, aes(x = Threshold, y = Net_Savings)) +
  geom_line(color = "#1f77b4", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "#1f77b4", size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = optimal_strategy$Threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "#d62728", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = optimal_strategy, aes(x = Threshold, y = Net_Savings), color = "#d62728", size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Frito-Lay Attrition Model: Profit Maximization Analysis",
    subtitle = paste("Maximum Net Savings of", scales::dollar(optimal_strategy$Net_Savings), 
                     "achieved at a classification threshold of", optimal_strategy$Threshold),
    x = "Classification Probability Threshold Cutoff",
    y = "Net Corporate Cost Savings ($)",
    caption = "Assumptions: Tiered Role Replacement Penalty (50%-400%) | $200 Incentive Care | 40% Mitigation Success Rate") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(savings_plot)

cat(paste("Optimal Probability Threshold :", optimal_strategy$Threshold, "\n"))
cat(paste("Total Risk Interventions Sent :", optimal_strategy$Employees_Flagged, "\n"))
cat(paste("High-Value Flight Averted     :", round(optimal_strategy$Turnovers_Averted, 1), "employees\n"))
cat(paste("Unmitigated Risk Exposure Cost: $", format(round(optimal_strategy$Baseline_Cost), big.mark=","), "\n"))
cat(paste("Mitigated Strategy Budget Cost: $", format(round(optimal_strategy$Model_Cost), big.mark=","), "\n"))
cat(paste("MAXIMIZED NET SAVINGS REALIZED: $", format(round(optimal_strategy$Net_Savings), big.mark=","), "\n"))

final_classes <- factor(ifelse(test_preds_prob > optimal_strategy$Threshold, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))
print(confusionMatrix(final_classes, test_set$Attrition, positive = "Yes"))
```

```{r best threshold}
library(pROC)
df_master <- read.csv("CaseStudy1-data.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
df_modeling <- df_master %>%
  select(-EmployeeCount, -StandardHours, -Over18, -EmployeeNumber, -ID)

set.seed(42)
idx <- createDataPartition(df_modeling$Attrition, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
m_train <- df_modeling[idx, ]
m_val   <- df_modeling[-idx, ]
nb_fit <- naiveBayes(Attrition ~ OverTime + JobRole + MonthlyIncome + 
                     MaritalStatus + DistanceFromHome, data = m_train)
nb_probs <- predict(nb_fit, newdata = m_val, type = "raw")
roc_obj <- roc(m_val$Attrition, nb_probs[, "Yes"], levels = c("No", "Yes"))

best_thresh <- coords(roc_obj, "best", ret = "threshold", best.method = "youden")
print(best_thresh$threshold)
```

```{r Model alt-alt}
final_classes <- factor(ifelse(test_preds_prob > optimal_strategy$Threshold, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))
print(confusionMatrix(final_classes, test_set$Attrition, positive = "Yes"))

knn_features <- c("MonthlyIncome", "DistanceFromHome", "TotalWorkingYears", "YearsAtCompany", "Age")

scaled_train <- scale(m_train[, knn_features])
scaled_val   <- scale(m_val[, knn_features], 
                     center = attr(scaled_train, "scaled:center"), 
                     scale = attr(scaled_train, "scaled:scale"))

k_values <- seq(1, 21, by = 2) 
knn_results <- data.frame(K = integer(), Sensitivity = numeric())

for (k_val in k_values) {
  predictions <- knn(train = scaled_train, test = scaled_val, 
                     cl = m_train$Attrition, k = k_val)
  
  loop_matrix <- confusionMatrix(predictions, m_val$Attrition, positive = "Yes")
  sens <- loop_matrix$byClass["Sensitivity"]
  
  knn_results <- rbind(knn_results, data.frame(K = k_val, Sensitivity = sens))}

optimal_k <- knn_results %>% filter(Sensitivity == max(Sensitivity)) %>% head(1)

k_optimization_plot <- ggplot(knn_results, aes(x = K, y = Sensitivity)) +
  geom_line(color = "#1f77b4", linewidth = 1.2) + # Changed color to distinguish from accuracy chart
  geom_point(color = "#1f77b4", size = 3) +
  # Draw marker at the exact peak performance neighborhood coordinate
  geom_vline(xintercept = optimal_k$K, linetype = "dashed", color = "#d62728", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = optimal_k, aes(x = K, y = Sensitivity), color = "#d62728", size = 5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_values) +
  labs(
    title = "KNN Hyperparameter Tuning: Sensitivity Optimization Search",
    subtitle = paste("Absolute peak sensitivity of", scales::percent(optimal_k$Sensitivity, accuracy = 0.1), 
                     "achieved at k =", optimal_k$K),
    x = "Number of Neighbors (Value of K)",
    y = "Validation Set Sensitivity (%)",
    caption = "Evaluated via 80/20 out-of-sample data partitioning.") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(k_optimization_plot)

best_knn_preds <- knn(train = scaled_train, test = scaled_val, 
                      cl = m_train$Attrition, k = optimal_k$K)
knn_matrix <- confusionMatrix(best_knn_preds, m_val$Attrition, positive = "Yes")
print(knn_matrix)
```

```{r Model 1}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)

df_train <- read.csv("CaseStudy1-data.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
df_train_clean <- df_train %>%
  select(-EmployeeCount, -StandardHours, -Over18, -EmployeeNumber) %>%
  mutate(Attrition = factor(Attrition, levels = c("No", "Yes")))

set.seed(42)
splitIndex <- createDataPartition(df_train_clean$Attrition, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_slice <- df_train_clean[splitIndex, ]
val_slice   <- df_train_clean[-splitIndex, ]

train_balanced <- downSample(x = select(train_slice, -Attrition, -ID),
                             y = train_slice$Attrition,
                             yname = "Attrition")

rf_model <- randomForest(Attrition ~ OverTime + JobRole + MonthlyIncome + 
                         MaritalStatus + DistanceFromHome + TotalWorkingYears + 
                         YearsAtCompany + JobLevel + EnvironmentSatisfaction, 
                         data = train_balanced, ntree = 500, mtry = 3, importance = TRUE)

val_probs <- predict(rf_model, newdata = val_slice, type = "prob")[, "Yes"]

OPTIMAL_THRESHOLD <- 0.42

val_preds <- factor(ifelse(val_probs > OPTIMAL_THRESHOLD, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))
matrix_metrics <- confusionMatrix(val_preds, val_slice$Attrition, positive = "Yes")
print(matrix_metrics)

df_comp <- read.csv("CaseStudy1CompSet No Attrition.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
df_comp_clean <- df_comp %>%
    mutate(
      AnnualSalary = MonthlyIncome * 12,
      ReplacementCostMultiplier = case_when(
        JobLevel == 1 ~ 0.50,  
        JobLevel == 2 ~ 1.00,  
        JobLevel == 3 ~ 1.50,  
        JobLevel == 4 ~ 2.50,  
        JobLevel == 5 ~ 4.00,  
        TRUE          ~ 1.00),
      IndividualReplacementCost = AnnualSalary * ReplacementCostMultiplier)
 
  comp_probs <- predict(rf_model, newdata = df_comp, type = "prob")[, "Yes"]
  
  comp_predictions <- ifelse(comp_probs > OPTIMAL_THRESHOLD, "Yes", "No")
  comp_predictions <- factor(comp_predictions, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  
  output_payload <- data.frame(
    ID = df_comp$ID,
    Attrition = comp_predictions) %>% 
    arrange(ID) 
  
comp_counts <- table(output_payload$Attrition)
  print(comp_counts)
  
  comp_pcts <- round(prop.table(comp_counts) * 100, 2)
  cat(paste("Predicted Retained Profile ('No') :", comp_pcts["No"], "%\n"))
  cat(paste("Predicted Risk Profile     ('Yes'):", comp_pcts["Yes"], "%\n"))
  cat(paste("Total Verified Row Ingestion     :", nrow(output_payload), "out of 300 rows\n"))

  INCENTIVE_BUDGET     <- 200    
  PROGRAM_SUCCESS_RATE <- 0.40   
  
  financial_audit <- df_comp_clean %>%
    mutate(
      Predicted_Attrition = comp_predictions,
      Unmanaged_Exposure = IndividualReplacementCost)

  target_group <- financial_audit %>% filter(Predicted_Attrition == "Yes")
  
  estimated_unmitigated_losses <- sum(target_group$Unmanaged_Exposure)
  total_intervention_spend <- nrow(target_group) * INCENTIVE_BUDGET
  value_of_flights_averted <- estimated_unmitigated_losses * PROGRAM_SUCCESS_RATE
  net_corporate_savings <- value_of_flights_averted - total_intervention_spend
  
  cat(paste("Total Employees Evaluated      :", nrow(financial_audit), "Profiles\n"))
  cat(paste("High-Risk Proactive Alerts Sent:", nrow(target_group), "Employees\n"))
  cat(paste("Targeted Flights Safely Saved  :", round(nrow(target_group) * PROGRAM_SUCCESS_RATE, 1), "Employees\n"))
  cat(paste("Total Target Risk Exposure     : $", format(round(estimated_unmitigated_losses), big.mark=","), "\n"))
  cat(paste("Estimated Unmitigated Losses   : $", format(round(estimated_unmitigated_losses), big.mark=","), "\n"))
  cat(paste("Programmatic Outreach Spend    : $", format(round(total_intervention_spend), big.mark=","), "\n"))
  cat(paste("Gross Attrition Capital Saved  : $", format(round(value_of_flights_averted), big.mark=","), "\n"))
  cat(paste("NET MODEL-DRIVEN SAVINGS       : $", format(round(net_corporate_savings), big.mark=","), "\n"))
```

```{r Model 2}
                             y = train_slice$Attrition,
                             yname = "Attrition")

rf_model <- randomForest(Attrition ~ OverTime + JobRole + MonthlyIncome + 
                         MaritalStatus + DistanceFromHome + TotalWorkingYears + 
                         YearsAtCompany + JobLevel + EnvironmentSatisfaction +
                         JobInvolvement + WorkLifeBalance, 
                         data = train_balanced, 
                         ntree = 750,       
                         mtry = 3,          
                         importance = TRUE)

val_probs <- predict(rf_model, newdata = val_slice, type = "prob")[, "Yes"]

OPTIMAL_THRESHOLD <- 0.40

val_preds <- factor(ifelse(val_probs > OPTIMAL_THRESHOLD, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))
matrix_metrics <- confusionMatrix(val_preds, val_slice$Attrition, positive = "Yes")
print(matrix_metrics)

df_comp <- read.csv("CaseStudy1CompSet No Attrition.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
df_comp_clean <- df_comp %>%
  mutate(
    AnnualSalary = MonthlyIncome * 12,
    ReplacementCostMultiplier = case_when(
      JobLevel == 1 ~ 0.50,  
      JobLevel == 2 ~ 1.00,  
      JobLevel == 3 ~ 1.50,  
      JobLevel == 4 ~ 2.50,  
      JobLevel == 5 ~ 4.00,  
      TRUE          ~ 1.00),
    IndividualReplacementCost = AnnualSalary * ReplacementCostMultiplier)

comp_probs <- predict(rf_model, newdata = df_comp_clean, type = "prob")[, "Yes"]
comp_predictions <- ifelse(comp_probs > OPTIMAL_THRESHOLD, "Yes", "No")
comp_predictions <- factor(comp_predictions, levels = c("No", "Yes"))

output_payload <- data.frame(
  ID = df_comp_clean$ID,
  Attrition = comp_predictions) %>% 
  arrange(ID)

write.csv(output_payload, file = "Case1PredictionsSohn Attrition Model-2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n[SUCCESS]: 'Case1PredictionsSohn Attrition Model-2.csv' generated at 0.40 threshold standard.\n\n")

INCENTIVE_BUDGET     <- 200    
PROGRAM_SUCCESS_RATE <- 0.40   

financial_audit <- df_comp_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Predicted_Attrition = comp_predictions,
    Unmanaged_Exposure  = IndividualReplacementCost)

comp_counts              <- table(output_payload$Attrition)
comp_pcts                <- round(prop.table(comp_counts) * 100, 2)
target_group <- financial_audit %>% filter(Predicted_Attrition == "Yes")
  
  estimated_unmitigated_losses <- sum(target_group$Unmanaged_Exposure)
  total_intervention_spend <- nrow(target_group) * INCENTIVE_BUDGET
  value_of_flights_averted  <- estimated_unmitigated_losses * PROGRAM_SUCCESS_RATE
  net_corporate_savings <- value_of_flights_averted - total_intervention_spend
  
  cat(paste("Total Employees Evaluated      :", nrow(financial_audit), "Profiles\n"))
  cat(paste("High-Risk Proactive Alerts Sent:", nrow(target_group), "Employees\n"))
  cat(paste("Targeted Flights Safely Saved  :", round(nrow(target_group) * PROGRAM_SUCCESS_RATE, 1), "Employees\n"))
  cat(paste("Total Target Risk Exposure     : $", format(round(estimated_unmitigated_losses), big.mark=","), "\n"))
  cat(paste("Estimated Unmitigated Losses   : $", format(round(estimated_unmitigated_losses), big.mark=","), "\n"))
  cat(paste("Programmatic Outreach Spend    : $", format(round(total_intervention_spend), big.mark=","), "\n"))
  cat(paste("Gross Attrition Capital Saved  : $", format(round(value_of_flights_averted), big.mark=","), "\n"))
  cat(paste("NET MODEL-DRIVEN SAVINGS       : $", format(round(net_corporate_savings), big.mark=","), "\n"))
```

```{r RF Model 3}
df_train <- read.csv("CaseStudy1-data.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
df_train_clean <- df_train %>%
  select(-EmployeeCount, -StandardHours, -Over18, -EmployeeNumber) %>%
  mutate(Attrition = factor(Attrition, levels = c("No", "Yes")))

set.seed(42)
splitIndex <- createDataPartition(df_train_clean$Attrition, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_slice <- df_train_clean[splitIndex, ]
val_slice   <- df_train_clean[-splitIndex, ]

val_slice_clean <- val_slice %>%
  mutate(
    AnnualSalary = MonthlyIncome * 12,
    ReplacementCostMultiplier = case_when(
      JobLevel == 1 ~ 0.50,  
      JobLevel == 2 ~ 1.00,  
      JobLevel == 3 ~ 1.50,  
      JobLevel == 4 ~ 2.50,  
      JobLevel == 5 ~ 4.00,  
      TRUE          ~ 1.00),
    IndividualReplacementCost = AnnualSalary * ReplacementCostMultiplier)

train_balanced <- downSample(x = select(train_slice, -Attrition, -ID),
                             y = train_slice$Attrition,
                             yname = "Attrition")

rf_model <- randomForest(Attrition ~ OverTime + JobRole + MonthlyIncome + 
                         MaritalStatus + DistanceFromHome + TotalWorkingYears + 
                         YearsAtCompany + JobLevel + EnvironmentSatisfaction, 
                         data = train_balanced, ntree = 500, mtry = 3, importance = TRUE)

val_probs <- predict(rf_model, newdata = val_slice_clean, type = "prob")[, "Yes"]

INCENTIVE_BUDGET     <- 200    
PROGRAM_SUCCESS_RATE <- 0.40   

threshold_grid <- seq(0.10, 0.90, by = 0.01)
roi_results <- data.frame(Threshold = numeric(), NetSavings = numeric(), Sensitivity = numeric(), Specificity = numeric())

for (thresh in threshold_grid) {
  test_preds <- factor(ifelse(val_probs > thresh, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  matrix_metrics <- confusionMatrix(test_preds, val_slice_clean$Attrition, positive = "Yes")
  
  sens <- matrix_metrics$byClass["Sensitivity"]
  spec <- matrix_metrics$byClass["Specificity"]
  precision <- matrix_metrics$byClass["Pos Pred Value"] # Precision (Model Lift)
  
  if (is.na(precision)) precision <- 0
  
  target_cohort_val <- val_slice_clean[test_preds == "Yes", ]
  num_alerts <- nrow(target_cohort_val)
  
  if (num_alerts > 0) {
    unmitigated_losses <- sum(target_cohort_val$IndividualReplacementCost) * precision
    intervention_spend <- num_alerts * INCENTIVE_BUDGET
    flights_averted     <- unmitigated_losses * PROGRAM_SUCCESS_RATE
    net_savings        <- flights_averted - intervention_spend
  } else {
    net_savings        <- 0}
  
  roi_results <- rbind(roi_results, data.frame(Threshold = thresh, NetSavings = net_savings, Sensitivity = sens, Specificity = spec))}

best_roi_config <- roi_results %>% filter(NetSavings == max(NetSavings)) %>% head(1)
OPTIMAL_THRESHOLD <- best_roi_config$Threshold

roi_plot <- ggplot(roi_results, aes(x = Threshold, y = NetSavings)) +
  geom_line(color = "#1f77b4", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_area(fill = "#1f77b4", alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = OPTIMAL_THRESHOLD, linetype = "dashed", color = "#d62728", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = best_roi_config, aes(x = Threshold, y = NetSavings), color = "#d62728", size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format()) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Financial Optimization Curve Across Decision Thresholds",
    subtitle = paste0("Absolute peak ROI achieved at threshold = ", OPTIMAL_THRESHOLD, 
                      " (Expected Net Validation Savings: ", scales::dollar(best_roi_config$NetSavings), ")"),
    x = "Classification Probability Threshold (Cutoff)",
    y = "Expected Net Model-Driven Savings ($)",
    caption = "Optimized via validation cohort using programmatic intervention constraints.") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray30", size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(roi_plot)

cat(paste("    ROI MAXIMUM INTERVENTION THRESHOLD FOUND:", OPTIMAL_THRESHOLD, "   \n"))
cat(paste("Expected Validation Net Savings  : $", format(round(best_roi_config$NetSavings), big.mark=","), "\n"))
cat(paste("Model Sensitivity at Peak ROI    :", round(best_roi_config$Sensitivity * 100, 2), "%\n"))
cat(paste("Model Specificity at Peak ROI    :", round(best_roi_config$Specificity * 100, 2), "%\n"))

val_preds <- factor(ifelse(val_probs > OPTIMAL_THRESHOLD, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))
matrix_metrics <- confusionMatrix(val_preds, val_slice_clean$Attrition, positive = "Yes")
MODEL_PRECISION <- matrix_metrics$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]
if (is.na(MODEL_PRECISION)) MODEL_PRECISION <- 0

df_comp <- read.csv("CaseStudy1CompSet No Attrition.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
df_comp_clean <- df_comp %>%
    mutate(
      AnnualSalary = MonthlyIncome * 12,
      ReplacementCostMultiplier = case_when(
        JobLevel == 1 ~ 0.50,  
        JobLevel == 2 ~ 1.00,  
        JobLevel == 3 ~ 1.50,  
        JobLevel == 4 ~ 2.50,  
        JobLevel == 5 ~ 4.00,  
        TRUE          ~ 1.00),
      IndividualReplacementCost = AnnualSalary * ReplacementCostMultiplier)
 
comp_probs <- predict(rf_model, newdata = df_comp, type = "prob")[, "Yes"]
comp_predictions <- factor(ifelse(comp_probs > OPTIMAL_THRESHOLD, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))

output_payload <- data.frame(ID = df_comp$ID, Attrition = comp_predictions) %>% arrange(ID) 
write.csv(output_payload, file = "Case1PredictionsSohn Attrition-Model 3.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n[SUCCESS]: 'Case1PredictionsSohn Attrition-Model 3.csv' generated cleanly.\n\n")

financial_audit <- df_comp_clean %>%
  mutate(Predicted_Attrition = comp_predictions, Unmanaged_Exposure = IndividualReplacementCost)

target_group <- financial_audit %>% filter(Predicted_Attrition == "Yes")
estimated_unmitigated_losses <- sum(target_group$Unmanaged_Exposure) * MODEL_PRECISION
total_intervention_spend <- nrow(target_group) * INCENTIVE_BUDGET
value_of_flights_averted  <- estimated_unmitigated_losses * PROGRAM_SUCCESS_RATE
net_corporate_savings <- value_of_flights_averted - total_intervention_spend

cat(paste("Total Employees Evaluated      :", nrow(financial_audit), "Profiles\n"))
cat(paste("High-Risk Proactive Alerts Sent:", nrow(target_group), "Employees\n"))
cat(paste("Targeted Flights Safely Saved  :", round(nrow(target_group) * MODEL_PRECISION * PROGRAM_SUCCESS_RATE, 1), "Employees\n"))
cat(paste("Total Target Risk Exposure     : $", format(round(sum(target_group$Unmanaged_Exposure)), big.mark=","), "\n"))
cat(paste("Estimated Unmitigated Losses   : $", format(round(estimated_unmitigated_losses), big.mark=","), "\n"))
cat(paste("Programmatic Outreach Spend    : $", format(round(total_intervention_spend), big.mark=","), "\n"))
cat(paste("Gross Attrition Capital Saved  : $", format(round(value_of_flights_averted), big.mark=","), "\n"))
cat(paste("NET MODEL-DRIVEN SAVINGS       : $", format(round(net_corporate_savings), big.mark=","), "\n"))
```
